messages:
maria_pm: Kicking off Q2 release sequencing for "Edge Cache + Private Deploy" initiative. Sync 3pm PT today. Drop known deps/blockers here + owners. Need a minimal critical path by EOD.

alex_eng: From eng: main deps I see are: 1) KV cache sharding (infra) 2) Private control-plane auth (security) 3) model quantization variant (ml). KV sharding ETA ~2w if infra slot holds. Owner: sam_platform.

sam_platform: Confirming KV sharding scheduling — we have a slot week of Apr 4 but might slip if GPUs are reallocated. Need approval for extra quota. @maria_pm can you flag? :eyes: 

jenna_design: UX note: private console needs a tiny flow update + permissions matrix. I can do mocks in ~3 days once PM spec arrives.

kevin_qa: QA: migration tests for cache warmup + rollback plan are must-haves. Need a staging perf harness and testcases. Will pair with eng.

maria_pm: Proposed launch criteria: 95p tail latency within 20% of baseline, successful canary for 72h, automated rollback verified. Customers in scope for sign-off: Acme & HealthCo (VPC + KMS). Add them to final checklist.

alex_eng: Suggested sequence: infra quota -> private CP auth -> model quant -> console UX -> canary. If quota slips, we can ship with a quant polyfill fallback to keep latency in range.

sam_platform: I'll open the quota request now. Also flag: config migration script touches Dedicated clusters and needs an oncall window. Proposed window: Apr 9 02:00-05:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window created: id mt-20260409-02 (automated)

kevin_qa: For the canary let's define user slice + gating metrics: error_rate, 95p latency, token_cost. I'll draft a gating dashboard and test plan.

maria_pm: Action items from this thread: @sam_platform -> request quota & migration plan (owner sam_platform), @alex_eng -> fallback plan for quant polyfill, @jenna_design -> spec + copy, @kevin_qa -> perf harness + gating dashboard. I'll assemble a dependency heatmap after the sync and circulate a one-pager.

alex_eng: Ack. I'll post a brief Gantt/GitHub milestone snippet in the channel before the meeting.

jenna_design: Ack and will prep mockups based on the spec notes.

sam_platform: Quota request filed: https://internal/tickets/INC-4152 — added estimated lead time and contact.

maria_pm: Perfect — see you all 3pm. If anyone hits a hard blocker before then ping me directly or DM. :+1:
